prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Three generations share a relaxed moment in an ordinary living room: a 72-year-old grandmother, her 39-year-old adult daughter, and an 8-year-old child sit close together looking at an unlabelled family album. The child points to a photograph while the adults smile. Use afternoon window light, lived-in furniture, and unobtrusive eye-level group framing. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective. Important composition refinement: show exactly THREE people only: a grandmother with long silver hair in a loose braid, her daughter with a short dark pixie haircut, and a red-haired child. They sit close together in the MIDDLE HALF of a sofa looking at one open plain family photo album. Use a noticeably WIDER room view, showing generous empty sofa and room space on BOTH left and right outer quarters. ALL three faces, their arms and the album must fit completely inside the CENTRAL 55 percent of the full image width and central 70 percent of its height. Never fill the frame edge-to-edge with bodies. Soft cool-neutral daylight, ordinary untidy real home, different new invented faces, understated asymmetrical expressions.
review: Accepted after regenerating: three generations centred around an album, distinct ages/hair, natural separate hands, full group fits a central 4:3 crop.
